I bought 2 replacement shelves for my refrigerator for the two bottom slots on the door.  These were to be the correct items for my refrigerator model.  I can’t use them because they are constantly falling off.

These shelves are advertised as "exact replacements".  They are not as I had to carefully bend the plastic "tabs" outward to go over the "nubs" they are supposed to attach to.  As they are plastic I was concerned about them snapping off when I did this.  I had to try each shelf in each location to find the "best fit" as they did not both fit the same.  Eventually I did get them on but the bottom shelf is still not fully "seated" as it should be.
Why spend 2x to 3x as much on one that claims to be OEM, when this one is identical to the one which comes with your fridge.

My Dryer stopped working, unless I would push and hold the door, or Jam a broom between the wall and the door to push it in. I decided to give this a try instead of hiring someone (or buying a new dryer). I popped the old one out with a screw driver and put this one in(which took me a total of maybe one minute), and my drier is as good as new again! I a so happy!
Also, even though shipping was estimated to take a couple of weeks, it showed up in the mail 4 days after I ordered it.

Got tired of wedging the broom against the door of my Kenmore 90 Series dryer.  Saw that the latch was worn so replaced it with this.  Quick and easy repair and worked as stated.  One thing to check before purchasing - While in the process of removing the dryer door, discovered that one of the hinge springs had popped off.  Not sure if that was what was causing the door to pop open mid-cycle, but may have been part of the issue.  I would have fixed that before purchasing the new latch had I discovered it first.
